notes: No entry is a deployed connector, legal license, canonical contract, authorization or source-byte grant.
Platforms can offer multiple access methods; cataloguing a route does not prove it works for a given account or item.
Owner of acquisition/custody is upstream; DaAT maps/admission with explicit contracts only.
Manual ChatGPT handoffs are limited by permission to share data; login alone never grants disclosure rights.
Bibliographic metadata, abstracts, excerpts and full text have distinct epistemic and legal coverage.
API documentation verified for selected platforms only; all other modes require dedicated owner verification.
